content:
Apple One will become more practical in iOS 27, as subscribers will be able to enjoy a series of new features on bundled Apple services (such as iCloud+ and Apple Music). The following is an introduction to the new features.

One: Gain more Apple Intelligence features

iOS 27 brings major Apple Intelligence upgrades, including a brand-new Siri AI, powerful editing tools for Apple Photos, enhanced image generation features, and more.

Although these features will be offered to all users for free, some features have daily usage caps — and the cap will increase based on the Apple One plan tier you subscribe to.

It is still unclear how much the AI usage cap will be raised. However, since every Apple One plan includes iCloud+, recent evidence suggests the cap will progressively increase with each plan tier.

Two: Four new upgrades for HomeKit Secure Video

HomeKit Secure Video is another iCloud+ benefit that will receive four new features in iOS 27. Apple says:

  • 4K video: "Supported HomeKit Secure Video cameras can now stream and record 4K video"
  • Automatically generated video descriptions: "Users can quickly understand what happened in a series of clips without having to watch them one by one"
  • Clip search: "Users can easily find the content they want, such as footage of a package delivery"
  • Featured clips collection: "At the top of the search page, the Home app will display the featured clip collections users most want to see, helping them quickly grasp important moments"

After iOS 27 launches, all Apple One subscribers will be able to use each of the new features above. You only need a compatible smart camera and home hub. Here are my personal recommendations:

  • Aqara G100 2K security camera: $39, an extremely high value-for-money choice
  • eufy 4K security camera: supports 4K recording, reasonably priced at just $54

Three: Apple Music improvements

Finally, Apple Music will also receive many new features and improvements in iOS 27.

  • Redesigned artist and album pages
  • Horizontal playback interface on iPhone
  • AutoMix brings "more immersive, more engaging transition effects"
  • AutoMix lands on Apple TV and HomePod
  • tvOS 27 supports Hi-Res Lossless audio streaming

In addition, lyrics translation and lyrics pronunciation features will support more languages. Apple says:

Lyrics translation will add seven new language pairs, allowing seamless translation of lyrics for users' favourite songs, including English to French, German, Italian, Korean, Spanish; French to English; and Japanese to English. […] The lyrics pronunciation feature lets users sing along in another language, and will also add five new language pairs, including Arabic to romanised Arabic, English to Korean text, English to katakana, Japanese to Korean text, and Simplified Chinese to katakana.

Apple also highlighted several important bug fixes, including improved streaming stability, faster loading of the playback interface, and quicker playback startup.

Which Apple One feature in iOS 27 are you most looking forward to? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.

Apple One starts at $19.95 per month and includes Apple TV+, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.

Featured iPhone accessories

  • AirPods Pro 3 (now just $189, originally $249)
  • iPhone MagSafe car mount
  • AirTag 10-year battery protective case
  • AirTag 2 (single pack / four-pack)
  • 100W USB-C fast charging power adapter
